title.zh-Hant: 香港設計與建築本科 2027 申請匯總：港大 Design+、理大設計、科大 IDT、中大建築（2026 年 10 月官網查核）
title.en: Hong Kong design and architecture undergraduate degrees for 2027 entry: HKU Design+, PolyU Design, HKUST IDT and CUHK Architecture (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 重新對照港大、理大、科大、中大官網，整理四個設計與建築本科課程的 2027 年入學申請重點：學位數、作品集格式、入學測驗、面試與截止日，並附申請時間表建議。
summary.en: Rechecked against the official websites of HKU, PolyU, HKUST and CUHK: places, portfolio formats, admission tests, interviews and deadlines for four design and architecture undergraduate programmes for 2027 entry, plus a suggested timeline.

tldr.zh-Hant: 2027 年入學：港大 BASc(Design+) 第一年 20 個學位，只需至少一件創意作品（PDF ≤10 MB），非 JUPAS 第一輪 2026/11/25 中午截止、最終 2027/8/25 截止。理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Design（JS3569）招生 83 人、九個方向，國際生無作品集不予考慮，作品集 A3、20–30 頁、≤20 MB，面試 11 月至 4 月以 Zoom 英文進行。科大 ISD 已以 BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology（IDT）招生，須高階數學加一科理科，優先輪 2026/11/25、2027/6/30 截止。中大 BSSc (Architectural Studies)（JS4812）要作品集＋入學測驗＋面試，非 JUPAS 提前輪 2026/11/12、正常輪 2027/1/7 截止。
tldr.en: For 2027 entry: HKU BASc(Design+) has 20 first-year places and needs at least one creative work (PDF up to 10 MB); the non-JUPAS first round closes at noon on 25 November 2026 and applications close on 25 August 2027. PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Design (JS3569) admits 83 across nine specialisms; international applications without a portfolio are not considered; the portfolio is A3, 20–30 pages, up to 20 MB, with English Zoom interviews from November to April. HKUST ISD now recruits as the BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology (IDT), requiring senior-level mathematics plus one science subject; the priority round closes on 25 November 2026 and applications on 30 June 2027. CUHK BSSc (Architectural Studies) (JS4812) requires a portfolio, an admission test and an interview; the non-JUPAS Advance Offer Round closes on 12 November 2026 and the Regular Round on 7 January 2027.

body.zh-Hant:
香港的設計與建築本科，共同特色是「四年制、時程早、作品集份量重」：本文四個課程都是四年制，而且都要求作品集、測驗或面試其中至少一項。這篇把常被問到的四個本科課程——港大 BASc(Design+)、理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Design、科大 BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology、中大 BSSc (Architectural Studies)——的 2027 年入學申請重點，重新對照各校官網整理一次。舊資料中的日期、排名與已更名的課程名稱都已更新或刪除。

以下資訊於 2026 年 10 月查核；各校仍可能調整，送件前請以官網連結為準。

文首封面是理大設計學院作品集準備頁上的 Creative Portfolio 示意作品。圖片來源：香港理工大學 官網

四個課程一覽：先看定位再選校

  • 港大 BASc(Design+)：建築學院開設的跨學科設計學位，重設計思維、創新與創業；第一年只有 20 個學位。
  • 理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Design：香港選擇最多的設計本科，入學後再分流到九個專業方向，2027 年招生 83 人（JUPAS 與非 JUPAS 合計）。
  • 科大 BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology（IDT）：偏工程與科技的設計學位，理科背景是硬性要求。
  • 中大 BSSc (Architectural Studies)：建築學本科，要交作品集、做入學測驗並參加面試，課程獲 HKIA、香港建築師註冊管理局與 RIBA 認可。

港大 BASc(Design+)：一件創意作品就能申請

港大 Design+ 屬於建築學院（Faculty of Architecture），四年制，第一年學位只有 20 個，是四個課程中最小班的一個。作品集門檻反而最寬：申請者只需提交至少一件創意作品（美術、寫作或其他形式的創作都可以），以 PDF、不超過 10 MB 提交，不需要紙本；通過初選者會被邀請面試。

  • 國際／非 JUPAS 申請：作品集與第一輪評估截止為 2026 年 11 月 25 日中午 12 點（香港時間）；申請最晚 2027 年 8 月 25 日中午截止；面試在 2027 年 1 月下旬及 3 月至 7 月。
  • JUPAS（香港文憑試）申請：課程代碼 6236，申請與作品集截止 2026 年 12 月 2 日；面試在 2027 年 6 月中及 7 月下旬，通常只考慮 Band A 申請者。

建議：學位少、第一輪在 11 月就截止，想申請的同學不要等到隔年夏天。那一件作品要能看出你的思考過程，而不只是好看的成品。

理大設計學院：九個方向、作品集規格最明確

理大 JS3569 是「組合課程」，2027 年 9 月入學，四年制、120 學分，九個專業方向為：廣告設計、環境設計、沉浸式媒體與遊戲設計、信息設計、交互設計、室內設計、產品設計、服務創新設計、社會創新設計。對國際申請者，官網明寫沒有作品集的申請不會被考慮；作品集須在早輪或主輪截止前提交，入圍者會在 11 月至隔年 4 月以 Zoom 進行約 15–20 分鐘的英文面試。設計學院招生頁也說明，早輪考慮的截止日在 2026 年 11 月。

理大的作品集分兩種：有藝術設計背景的人準備 Creative Portfolio（平面、立體作品照片、多媒體等）；非藝術背景但對設計有興趣的人可以準備 Maker Portfolio（創意概念、研究、程式、模型原型、STEM／社區／創業項目等）。格式要求：

  • A3、20–30 頁、PDF 不超過 20 MB、英文。
  • 放 5–10 個最好的項目，其中至少一個要呈現發展過程。
  • 每個項目附標題與一句或一小段說明。
  • 附 200 字個人陳述：你的興趣、熱情，以及為什麼想讀理大設計學院。

JUPAS 申請者則必須把此課程放在 Band A，6 月中提交作品集，7 月文憑試放榜後入圍面試。

科大 IDT：舊稱 ISD，理科要求是門檻

科大的綜合系統與設計（BSc in Integrative Systems and Design，ISD）在 2027 年招生資料中已以 BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology（IDT）出現（JUPAS 代碼 JS5711；香港教育局 2026/27 校長推薦計劃文件註明「previously known as BSc in Integrative Systems and Design」）。非 JUPAS 申請者須具備高中高階數學，加上一科物理、化學、生物、電腦或設計與科技等高階科目。

國際學歷申請時程：2026 年 10 月 2 日開放申請系統，優先輪截止 2026 年 11 月 25 日，之後滾動審理，12 月下旬起陸續發放錄取，2027 年 6 月 30 日截止，申請費港幣 600 元。要準備個人陳述、10 年級起的成績單、英語能力證明與推薦人。

中大建築學：作品集＋入學測驗＋面試三關

中大 BSSc (Architectural Studies)（JUPAS 代碼 JS4812）除了大學一般入學要求，還要完成三項：設計作品集、入學測驗（依題目繪圖）、入學面試。

  • 非 JUPAS：提前錄取輪 2026 年 11 月 12 日申請截止，作品集與入學測驗 11 月 15 日前完成（測驗題目須在 11 月 8 日前產生）；正常輪申請 2027 年 1 月 7 日截止，作品集與測驗 1 月 10 日前完成（題目須在 1 月 3 日前產生）。面試在 2026 年 12 月至 2027 年 8 月滾動進行。
  • JUPAS：2026 年 12 月 2 日前完成 JUPAS 申請；作品集 2027 年 5 月 9 日前提交；放在 Band A 的申請者須在 5 月 9 日前完成入學測驗（5 月 2 日前產生題目，產生後一週內交圖）；面試在 5 月下旬或 6 月初，文憑試 7 月放榜後可能再有一輪。

入學測驗是在產生題目後一週內交圖，代表手繪與空間表達能力要平時就練好，無法臨時準備。

2027 申請者的時間表建議

根據 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的經驗，香港設計本科最容易失分的不是成績，而是時間：

  1. 10 月前：決定方向。偏設計思維與跨領域選港大；想讀明確設計專業選理大；理科強、想做產品與科技選科大；目標是建築師選中大。
  2. 11 月中下旬：四校的第一波截止都在這裡（中大提前輪 11/12–11/15、港大與科大 11/25、理大早輪 11 月），作品集最好在 10 月底定稿。
  3. 12 月至隔年春季：面試季。理大是英文 Zoom 面試；港大與中大的入圍者也要面試，都要能清楚講解自己的項目與思考過程。

結論

香港四校的設計與建築本科，各自要的人不一樣：港大看創意與跨領域潛力，理大看作品集的完整度，科大看理科與動手能力，中大看建築的空間思考與手繪。先選對課程，再照各校規格準備作品集，比起同一份作品集投遍所有學校，成功率高得多。
body.en:
Design and architecture undergraduate degrees in Hong Kong share three traits: four-year structures, early deadlines and a heavy weight on portfolios. All four programmes here last four years and require at least one of a portfolio, a test or an interview. This guide rechecks the 2027-entry requirements of four frequently asked-about programmes on each school's official website: HKU BASc(Design+), PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Design, HKUST BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology, and CUHK BSSc (Architectural Studies). Outdated dates, rankings and renamed programme titles from older material have been updated or removed.

All information was checked in October 2026. Schools may still make changes, so confirm with the official links before you submit.

The cover image shows Creative Portfolio sample work from the PolyU School of Design portfolio preparation page. Image source: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University official website

The four programmes at a glance

  • HKU BASc(Design+): an interdisciplinary design degree from the Faculty of Architecture, focused on design thinking, innovation and entrepreneurship, with only 20 first-year places.
  • PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Design: Hong Kong's broadest design degree, with nine specialisms; the 2027 intake is 83 (JUPAS and non-JUPAS combined).
  • HKUST BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology (IDT): an engineering- and technology-oriented design degree with firm science requirements.
  • CUHK BSSc (Architectural Studies): an architecture degree requiring a portfolio, an admission test and an interview, accredited by the HKIA, the Architects Registration Board (HKSAR) and RIBA.

HKU BASc(Design+): one creative work is enough to apply

HKU Design+ sits in the Faculty of Architecture, runs four years and has just 20 first-year places, the smallest of the four. Its portfolio requirement is the lightest: submit at least one example of creative work (fine art, writing or another creative form) as a PDF no larger than 10 MB; no hard copy is needed. Shortlisted candidates are invited to an interview.

  • International / non-JUPAS: the portfolio and first-round evaluation deadline is 12:00 noon, 25 November 2026 (HK time); applications close at noon on 25 August 2027; interviews run in late January 2027 and from March to July 2027.
  • JUPAS (HKDSE): programme code 6236, with applications and portfolios due 2 December 2026; interviews in mid-June and late July 2027, normally for Band A applicants only.

Advice: with so few places and a first round that closes in November, do not wait until the following summer. Your one piece should show how you think, not just a polished result.

PolyU School of Design: nine specialisms and the clearest portfolio rules

PolyU JS3569 is a scheme for September 2027 entry: four years, 120 credits, with nine specialisms: Advertising Design, Environmental Design, Immersive Media and Game Design, Information Design, Interaction Design, Interior Design, Product Design, Service Design and Social Design. For international applicants the website states that applications without portfolios will not be considered. Portfolios are due by the early-round or main-round deadline, and shortlisted applicants have a Zoom interview in English of about 15–20 minutes between November and April. The School of Design admissions page says the early round of consideration is due in November 2026.

There are two portfolio types: applicants with an art and design background prepare a Creative Portfolio (2D work, photographed 3D work, multimedia); applicants from other backgrounds who are interested in design can prepare a Maker Portfolio (creative concepts, research, creative coding, models and prototypes, STEM, community or entrepreneurship projects). The format:

  • A3, 20–30 pages, a PDF of no more than 20 MB, in English.
  • Five to ten of your best projects, including the development work for at least one.
  • A title and a one-sentence or short-paragraph description for each project.
  • A 200-word personal statement on your interests, your passions and why you want to study at the School of Design.

JUPAS applicants must place the programme as their Band A choice, submit a portfolio in mid-June and, once HKDSE results are out in July, may be shortlisted for an interview.

HKUST IDT: formerly ISD, with science as the threshold

HKUST's BSc in Integrative Systems and Design (ISD) appears in 2027 admissions materials as the BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology (IDT) (JUPAS code JS5711; the Hong Kong Education Bureau's 2026/27 School Nominations Direct Admission Scheme document notes it was "previously known as BSc in Integrative Systems and Design"). Non-JUPAS applicants need senior-level mathematics plus one senior-level subject such as physics, chemistry, biology, computer studies or design technology.

The timeline for international qualifications: the application system opened on 2 October 2026, the priority round closes on 25 November 2026, applications are then reviewed on a rolling basis with offers from late December, and applications close on 30 June 2027. The fee is HKD 600. You will need a personal statement, school reports from Grade 10 onwards, proof of English proficiency and an academic referee.

CUHK Architectural Studies: portfolio, admission test and interview

Besides the university's general requirements, CUHK BSSc (Architectural Studies) (JUPAS code JS4812) asks for three things: a design portfolio, an admission test (a drawing in response to a set question) and an interview.

  • Non-JUPAS: the Advance Offer Round closes on 12 November 2026, with the portfolio and admission test due by 15 November (the test question must be generated by 8 November); the Regular Round closes on 7 January 2027, with the portfolio and test due by 10 January (question generated by 3 January). Interviews run on a rolling basis from December 2026 to August 2027.
  • JUPAS: apply through JUPAS by 2 December 2026; submit the portfolio by 9 May 2027; Band A applicants must complete the admission test by 9 May (generate the question by 2 May and submit drawings within a week); interviews are in late May or early June, with a possible further round after HKDSE results in July.

Because the drawings are due within a week of generating the question, hand drawing and spatial expression have to be practised well in advance; they cannot be crammed.

A suggested timeline for 2027 applicants

From 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consultation, the most common way to lose ground in Hong Kong design applications is not grades but timing:

  1. By October: choose your direction. Design thinking and interdisciplinary work point to HKU; a defined design specialism points to PolyU; strong science and an interest in products and technology point to HKUST; becoming an architect points to CUHK.
  2. Mid to late November: all four schools have their first deadlines here (CUHK advance round 12–15 November, HKU and HKUST 25 November, PolyU early round in November), so aim to finalise your portfolio by the end of October.
  3. December to spring: interview season. PolyU's Zoom interview is in English, and shortlisted HKU and CUHK applicants are interviewed too, so be ready to explain your projects and thinking clearly.

Conclusion

Each of the four schools looks for something different: HKU for creativity and interdisciplinary potential, PolyU for a complete portfolio, HKUST for science and hands-on ability, and CUHK for spatial thinking and hand drawing in architecture. Choosing the right programme first and then tailoring your portfolio to each school's rules works far better than sending one portfolio everywhere.

q.zh-Hant: 港大 BASc(Design+) 作品集要準備多少作品？
q.en: How much work does the HKU BASc(Design+) portfolio need?

a.zh-Hant: 至少一件創意作品即可（美術、寫作或其他創作形式），以 PDF 提交、不超過 10 MB，不需紙本。國際／非 JUPAS 申請者須在 2026 年 11 月 25 日中午（香港時間）前提交，JUPAS 申請者為 2026 年 12 月 2 日。
a.en: At least one example of creative work (fine art, writing or another creative form), submitted as a PDF of no more than 10 MB; no hard copy is needed. International and non-JUPAS applicants submit by noon on 25 November 2026 (HK time); JUPAS applicants by 2 December 2026.

q.zh-Hant: 理大設計學院的作品集格式是什麼？
q.en: What format does the PolyU School of Design portfolio use?

a.zh-Hant: A3、20–30 頁、英文 PDF、不超過 20 MB，放 5–10 個最好的項目（至少一個呈現發展過程），每個項目附標題與說明，並附 200 字個人陳述。有藝術背景可準備 Creative Portfolio，非藝術背景可準備 Maker Portfolio。
a.en: A3, 20–30 pages, an English PDF of up to 20 MB, with five to ten of your best projects (development work for at least one), a title and description for each, and a 200-word personal statement. Applicants with an art background prepare a Creative Portfolio; others can prepare a Maker Portfolio.

q.zh-Hant: 科大 ISD 還有招生嗎？
q.en: Does HKUST still admit students to ISD?

a.zh-Hant: 2027 年招生資料中，原 BSc in Integrative Systems and Design 已以 BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology（IDT，JS5711）出現。非 JUPAS 申請者須具備高階數學，加上一科物理、化學、生物、電腦或設計與科技等高階科目。
a.en: In 2027 admissions materials the former BSc in Integrative Systems and Design appears as the BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology (IDT, JS5711). Non-JUPAS applicants need senior-level mathematics plus one senior-level subject such as physics, chemistry, biology, computer studies or design technology.

q.zh-Hant: 中大建築本科要考試嗎？
q.en: Does CUHK Architectural Studies have an admission test?

a.zh-Hant: 要。中大 BSSc (Architectural Studies) 須提交設計作品集、完成入學測驗（產生題目後一週內交圖），入圍者再參加面試。非 JUPAS 提前輪測驗須在 2026 年 11 月 15 日前完成，正常輪在 2027 年 1 月 10 日前完成。
a.en: Yes. CUHK BSSc (Architectural Studies) requires a design portfolio and an admission test (drawings due within a week of generating the question), followed by an interview for shortlisted applicants. For non-JUPAS applicants the test is due by 15 November 2026 in the Advance Offer Round and by 10 January 2027 in the Regular Round.

title.zh-Hant: 香港藝術＋科技本科 2027 申請：城大創意媒體、浸大藝術及科技、理大時裝（2026 年 10 月官網查核）
title.en: Hong Kong art and technology undergraduate degrees for 2027 entry: CityU Creative Media, HKBU Arts and Technology and PolyU Fashion (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 重新對照城大、浸大、理大官網，整理三個「藝術＋科技」本科課程的 2027 年入學申請重點：課程定位、作品集格式、面試與截止日，並附選校建議。
summary.en: Rechecked against the official websites of CityU, HKBU and PolyU: positioning, portfolio formats, interviews and deadlines for three art-and-technology undergraduate programmes for 2027 entry, plus advice on choosing.

tldr.zh-Hant: 2027 年入學：城大 BSc Creative Media（直接申請 1043）由創意媒體學院與電腦科學系合開，作品集 PDF 最多 10 頁 A4、≤8 MB、最多 5 個連結，本地直接申請提前輪 2026/11/15 截止，國際生須在申請後 10 個曆日內交作品集。浸大 BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology（JS2920）招生 40 人，要交三件作品（單一檔案 <30 MB），無作品集不處理，英文面試。理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion（JS3050）招生 101 人，一年後分流五個方向（含時裝創新及科技），國際與非 JUPAS 申請 2026/11/17 截止。
tldr.en: For 2027 entry: CityU BSc Creative Media (direct application code 1043) is run by SCM and Computer Science; the portfolio is a PDF of up to 10 A4 pages, 8 MB and 5 links; the local direct early round closes on 15 November 2026, and international applicants upload portfolios within 10 calendar days of applying. HKBU BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology (JS2920) has 40 places and requires three works in one file under 30 MB; applications without a portfolio are not processed, and interviews are in English. PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion (JS3050) has 101 places and streams students into five specialisms, including Fashion Innovation and Technology, after Year One; international and non-JUPAS applications close on 17 November 2026.

body.zh-Hant:
香港的設計本科，除了大家熟悉的港大 Design+、理大設計學院、科大 IDT 與中大建築（見香港設計與建築本科 2027 申請匯總），還有一批把藝術與科技放在一起的課程：遊戲、動畫、互動裝置、AI 生成藝術、沉浸式媒體、時裝科技。這篇挑三個常被問到的課程——城大 BSc Creative Media、浸大 BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology、理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion——對照各校官網，整理 2027 年入學的申請重點。

以下資訊於 2026 年 10 月查核；各校仍可能調整，送件前請以官網連結為準。舊資料中的排名、薪資說法與已不存在的課程名稱都已刪除。

文首封面是浸大藝術及科技課程頁「Facilities」段落中的賽馬會創意校園外觀圖。圖片來源：香港浸會大學 官網

三個課程一覽：先看你偏「寫程式」還是「做作品」

  • 城大 BSc Creative Media：由創意媒體學院（SCM）與電腦科學系合開，電腦圖學、遊戲、UI/UX、動畫與互動媒體並重，程式比重最高。
  • 浸大 BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology（JS2920）：跨學科課程，2027/28 年招生 40 人，結合視覺藝術、音樂科技、電腦與 AI 生成藝術，強調和業界合作的項目。
  • 理大 BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion（JS3050）：時裝及紡織學院的組合課程，2027 年招生 101 人，入學一年後分流到五個方向，其中「時裝創新及科技」最接近數碼時尚。

城大 BSc Creative Media：程式與創作各占一半

城大的 BSc Creative Media 由創意媒體學院與電腦科學系的核心課組成：電腦科學這邊有程式設計、資料結構、網絡、演算法、軟件工程、電腦圖學與 AI 遊戲編程；創意媒體這邊有新媒體藝術、電腦動畫、電腦遊戲、視覺傳達、裝置與互動。適合同時對電腦技術與創意媒體有興趣、願意認真學寫程式的人。

直接（非 JUPAS）申請的入學方式有幾種：第一年入學可報 1043（BSc Creative Media），也可報 1041（學院收生，第一年後自由選三個主修之一）或 1040（CREATE）；已有 13 年學制學歷（含 IB、A-Level）者還可考慮進階入學 1468A。

  • 作品集：城大強烈建議所有直接申請者提交作品集（照片、繪畫、雕塑、音樂、影片、軟件、多媒體、寫作、科學項目都可以）；格式為 PDF、最多 10 頁 A4、不超過 8 MB、最多 5 個超連結，影音只看前 5 分鐘，須以英文準備或附英文字幕、說明。報多個 SCM 課程也只交一份。
  • 本地直接申請時程：申請期 2026 年 9 月 24 日至 2027 年 1 月 15 日，提前輪截止 2026 年 11 月 15 日；作品集提交期提前輪 2026 年 11 月 19–28 日、主輪 2027 年 2 月 4–13 日，逾期不收；面試約在 2027 年 3 月中。
  • 國際生與內地非高考生：須在提交網上申請後 10 個曆日內上傳作品集。

浸大 Arts and Technology：三件作品＋面試

浸大 JS2920 是四年制、128 學分的跨學科課程，2027/28 年招生 40 人，2027 年 9 月開課，以英文授課。課程核心包括 Coding for Creatives、Computing for Creatives、AI and Generative Arts、音樂與音訊科技、3D 軟件與原型、3D 沉浸式環境，三、四年級以跨學科合作項目與工作實習為主，最後完成榮譽畢業項目。

  • 作品集：國際與副學位申請者沒有提交作品集的申請不會被處理。要交三件近期創作（最好是近三年內），可以是傳統藝術、數位藝術與設計（互動、VR／AR、遊戲、App），或 STEAM 項目（電子、機械人、模型）。
  • 格式：全英文；每件作品寫明名稱、年份、具體媒材、尺寸、時長、連結，並註明個人或小組作品（小組要寫自己的角色）；每件至少一張成品圖，立體作品最好多角度；影音放連結、不超過 5 分鐘；三件合併成一個 PDF／Word／PowerPoint 檔，小於 30 MB，以申請編號命名。
  • 面試：依作品集篩選後以英文面試；JUPAS 申請者的面試預計在 2027 年 6 月（文憑試放榜前）及 7 月底（放榜後）。

浸大只看三件作品，所以每一件都要能說清楚：你用了什麼技術、為什麼這樣做、在小組裡負責什麼。

理大時裝：想做數碼時尚，看「時裝創新及科技」

理大 JS3050 BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion 是 2027 年 9 月入學、四年制（含一年共同課程）、120 學分，招生 101 人（JUPAS 與非 JUPAS 合計）。一年級結束時依志願、GPA 與面試表現分流到五個方向：時裝設計、針織時裝設計、內衣及運動服裝、時裝商務、時裝創新及科技；不分流者以 BA (Hons) in Fashion 畢業。

國際／其他學歷與非 JUPAS 第一年申請截止都是 2026 年 11 月 17 日，是三個課程中最早的一個，現在就要開始準備。

要注意的是，理大目前並沒有獨立的「數碼時尚」本科學位；想往虛擬服裝、3D 時裝方向發展，本科可以瞄準時裝創新及科技方向，碩士階段理大另有 MA in Fashion Design 的 Digital Fashion Innovation 方向。

怎麼選：從你手上的作品倒推

根據 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的經驗，藝術＋科技類本科最常見的問題，是作品集只有「好看的圖」，看不出技術與思考：

  1. 會寫程式、做過遊戲或互動作品：城大 BSc Creative Media 最對口，10 頁內放程式截圖之外，更要放成品與影片連結。
  2. 作品媒材多元、喜歡跨領域合作：浸大 Arts and Technology 只要三件作品，適合把每件做深、寫清楚媒材與角色。
  3. 對布料、服裝、材料有興趣：理大時裝，11 月 17 日截止，比其他兩校早。像上圖用彈性布料在框架中做空間的實驗，就是很好的起點。

結論

城大、浸大、理大時裝這三個課程都歡迎「藝術＋科技」背景的學生，但門檻不同：城大重程式與媒體創作的結合，浸大重三件作品的深度與跨領域能力，理大時裝重材料與時尚的專業方向。先確認截止日（理大 11/17、城大提前輪 11/15），再照各校的格式準備作品集，比同一份作品集投遍所有學校有效得多。
body.en:
Beyond the well-known HKU Design+, PolyU School of Design, HKUST IDT and CUHK Architecture (see our Hong Kong design and architecture undergraduate guide for 2027), Hong Kong has a group of degrees that put art and technology together: games, animation, interactive installations, AI-generated art, immersive media and fashion technology. This guide picks three frequently asked-about programmes, CityU BSc Creative Media, HKBU BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology and PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion, and checks their 2027-entry requirements against each school's official website.

All information was checked in October 2026. Schools may still make changes, so confirm with the official links before you submit. Rankings, salary claims and programme names that no longer exist in older material have been removed.

The cover image shows the Jockey Club Campus of Creativity from the Facilities section of the HKBU Arts and Technology programme page. Image source: Hong Kong Baptist University official website

The three programmes at a glance: do you lean towards code or towards making?

  • CityU BSc Creative Media: run jointly by the School of Creative Media (SCM) and the Department of Computer Science, covering computer graphics, games, UI/UX, animation and interactive media, with the heaviest coding load of the three.
  • HKBU BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology (JS2920): a transdisciplinary degree with 40 places for 2027/28, combining visual arts, music technology, computing and AI-generated art, with an emphasis on industry projects.
  • PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion (JS3050): a scheme from the School of Fashion and Textiles with 101 places for 2027; students choose one of five specialisms after Year One, and Fashion Innovation and Technology is the closest to digital fashion.

CityU BSc Creative Media: half code, half creative work

CityU's BSc Creative Media combines core courses from SCM and Computer Science. On the computing side there are programming, data structures, networking, algorithms, software engineering, computer graphics and AI game programming; on the creative side there are new media art, computer animation, computer games, visual communication, installation and interactivity. It suits students interested in both computing and creative media who are ready to take coding seriously.

Direct (non-JUPAS) applicants have several routes: apply to 1043 (BSc Creative Media) for first-year entry, or to 1041 (school-based admission with a free choice of three majors after Year One) or 1040 (CREATE); applicants with a 13-year school-leaving qualification (including IB and A-Level) can also consider Advanced Standing entry to 1468A.

  • Portfolio: CityU strongly encourages every direct applicant to submit one (photography, painting, sculpture, music, film, software, multimedia, writing and science projects all count). The format is a PDF of at most 10 A4 pages, no larger than 8 MB, with up to 5 hyperlinks; only the first 5 minutes of audio or video are reviewed, and work must be in English or carry English subtitles or captions. Submit one portfolio even if you apply to several SCM programmes.
  • Timeline for local direct applicants: applications run from 24 September 2026 to 15 January 2027, with an early-round deadline of 15 November 2026; portfolios are submitted from 19 to 28 November 2026 (early round) or 4 to 13 February 2027 (main round), with no late submissions; interviews are around mid-March 2027.
  • International and Chinese Mainland non-Gaokao applicants: upload the portfolio within 10 calendar days of submitting the online application.

HKBU Arts and Technology: three works plus an interview

HKBU JS2920 is a four-year, 128-unit transdisciplinary degree with 40 places for 2027/28, starting in September 2027 and taught in English. Core courses include Coding for Creatives, Computing for Creatives, AI and Generative Arts, audio and music technology, 3D software and prototyping, and 3D immersive environments; Years 3 and 4 centre on transdisciplinary collaboration projects and work experience, ending with an honours project.

  • Portfolio: for international and post-secondary applicants, applications without a portfolio will not be processed. Submit three recent works (ideally from the past three years): traditional art, digital arts and design (interactive, VR/AR, games, apps) or STEAM projects (electronics, robotics, model building).
  • Format: everything in English; for each work give the title, year, exact medium, size, duration and links, and say whether it is individual or group work (with your role for group work); include at least one image of each final result, ideally several angles for 3D work; link time-based work and keep it under 5 minutes; combine the three works into one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file under 30 MB, named with your application number.
  • Interview: applicants are shortlisted from their portfolios and interviewed in English; for JUPAS applicants interviews are planned for June 2027 (before HKDSE results) and the end of July 2027 (after results).

Because HKBU looks at only three works, each one has to explain itself: what technology you used, why you made those choices and what you did in a team.

PolyU Fashion: for digital fashion, look at Fashion Innovation and Technology

PolyU JS3050, the BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion, is for September 2027 entry: four years (including one year of common curriculum), 120 credits and 101 places (JUPAS and non-JUPAS combined). At the end of Year One students are placed in one of five specialisms based on preference, GPA and interview performance: Fashion Design, Knitwear Design, Contour Fashion and Activewear, Fashion Business, and Fashion Innovation and Technology; those who are not streamed graduate with a BA (Hons) in Fashion.

The deadline for international/other qualifications and non-JUPAS Year 1 applicants is 17 November 2026, the earliest of the three, so preparation should start now.

Note that PolyU does not currently offer a standalone "digital fashion" undergraduate degree. If you want to work on virtual garments and 3D fashion, aim for the Fashion Innovation and Technology specialism at undergraduate level; at master's level PolyU also offers a Digital Fashion Innovation pathway within its MA in Fashion Design.

How to choose: work backwards from the work you already have

From 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consultation, the most common problem with art-and-technology portfolios is that they show only attractive images, without the technology or the thinking behind them:

  1. You code, or have made games or interactive work: CityU BSc Creative Media fits best. Within 10 pages, show finished results and video links, not just screenshots of code.
  2. You work across many media and enjoy collaboration: HKBU Arts and Technology asks for only three works, so go deep on each and state the medium and your role clearly.
  3. You are drawn to fabric, clothing and materials: PolyU Fashion, with a 17 November deadline that is earlier than the other two. Experiments like the one above, building space with stretchy fabric in a frame, are a good starting point.

Conclusion

CityU, HKBU and PolyU Fashion all welcome students with an art-and-technology profile, but their thresholds differ: CityU values the combination of coding and media creation, HKBU the depth of three works and cross-disciplinary ability, and PolyU Fashion a professional direction in materials and fashion. Confirm the deadlines first (PolyU 17 November, CityU early round 15 November), then prepare a portfolio to each school's format; this works far better than sending one portfolio everywhere.

q.zh-Hant: 城大創意媒體學院的作品集有什麼格式要求？
q.en: What format does the CityU School of Creative Media portfolio use?

a.zh-Hant: PDF、最多 10 頁 A4、不超過 8 MB、最多 5 個超連結；影音放 YouTube、Vimeo 等連結，只看前 5 分鐘；須以英文準備或附英文字幕與說明。報多個 SCM 課程也只交一份。國際生須在提交申請後 10 個曆日內上傳。
a.en: A PDF of at most 10 A4 pages, no larger than 8 MB, with up to 5 hyperlinks; put audio and video on YouTube, Vimeo or similar, and only the first 5 minutes are reviewed; prepare it in English or add English subtitles and captions. Submit one portfolio even for several SCM programmes. International applicants upload it within 10 calendar days of applying.

q.zh-Hant: 浸大 Arts and Technology 要交幾件作品？
q.en: How many works does HKBU Arts and Technology require?

a.zh-Hant: 三件近期創作（最好是近三年內），全英文說明每件的名稱、年份、媒材、尺寸、時長與連結，並註明個人或小組作品；三件合併成一個 PDF／Word／PowerPoint 檔，小於 30 MB，以申請編號命名。沒有作品集的國際申請不會被處理。
a.en: Three recent works (ideally from the past three years), with the title, year, medium, size, duration and links of each described in English, stating whether it is individual or group work; combine them into one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file under 30 MB, named with your application number. International applications without a portfolio are not processed.

q.zh-Hant: 理大有數碼時尚本科嗎？
q.en: Does PolyU offer a digital fashion undergraduate degree?

a.zh-Hant: 目前沒有獨立的數碼時尚本科學位。理大 JS3050 BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion 在一年級後分流到五個方向，其中「時裝創新及科技」最接近；碩士階段另有 MA in Fashion Design 的 Digital Fashion Innovation 方向。JS3050 國際與非 JUPAS 申請 2026 年 11 月 17 日截止。
a.en: Not as a standalone degree. PolyU JS3050, the BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion, streams students into five specialisms after Year One, and Fashion Innovation and Technology is the closest; at master's level there is a Digital Fashion Innovation pathway in the MA in Fashion Design. International and non-JUPAS applications for JS3050 close on 17 November 2026.

q.zh-Hant: 不會寫程式，可以申請這些藝術＋科技課程嗎？
q.en: Can I apply to these art-and-technology programmes if I cannot code?

a.zh-Hant: 可以，但要選對課程。浸大 Arts and Technology 接受傳統藝術、數位藝術或 STEAM 作品；理大時裝看重材料與時尚方向；城大 BSc Creative Media 入學後有大量電腦科學課程，若完全不想寫程式，可考慮城大學院收生（1041）一年後再選主修。
a.en: Yes, if you pick the right programme. HKBU Arts and Technology accepts traditional art, digital art or STEAM work; PolyU Fashion values materials and fashion; CityU BSc Creative Media includes many computer science courses, so if you do not want to code at all, consider CityU school-based admission (1041) and choose a major after Year One.

posts.abstract_en: A 2027-entry guide to three Hong Kong art-and-technology undergraduate programmes, rechecked on official websites in October 2026. CityU BSc Creative Media (direct application code 1043) combines School of Creative Media and Computer Science courses; its portfolio is a PDF of up to 10 A4 pages and 8 MB with up to 5 links, and the local direct early round closes on 15 November 2026. HKBU BASc (Hons) in Arts and Technology (JS2920) has 40 places and requires three works in one file under 30 MB plus an English interview. PolyU BA (Hons) Scheme in Fashion (JS3050) has 101 places, streams students into five specialisms including Fashion Innovation and Technology after Year One, and closes international and non-JUPAS applications on 17 November 2026.
